messages:
sam-recruiter: Candidate (T. Nguyen) DM'd: their wheelchair-accessible ride was delayed and they may only arrive ~2:45pm for a 2pm loop. Theyre happy to do remote first but asked if we can guarantee an accessible room and an onsite greeter if they arrive late. Also asked about scent-free policy.

zoe-peopleops: Thanks for flagging. We have Quiet Room GF-A which is wheelchair accessible. I'll reserve and request a greeter. Scent-free note added. Remote fallback ready. @alex-it can you prep a loaner Mac w/ screen-reader settings just in case?

alex-it: Will prepare LOANER-7702 with high-contrast theme and screen-reader enabled. Placing at reception with "Accessible Pickup" label at 2:30pm.

mike-hiringmgr: Panel can shift to 3pm if they prefer in-person. If remote, Nina can host the breakout sessions and screen-share.

nina-panel: Happy to host remote. Also fine to wait until 3pm for in-person. Please let candidate know we can hold lunch and offer low-fragrance meals.

facilities-bot: Quiet Room GF-A reserved 14:30-16:30. Greeter assigned: Jordan. Scent-free catering flagged. Accessible badge hold created.

zoe-peopleops: Reimbursement: if candidate pays for accessible transport, receipts to people-ops@redwood.ai subject "Candidate Expense - Nguyen". I'll DM the candidate the options and confirm which they prefer.

sam-recruiter: I messaged the candidate: they prefer remote for the first two interviews and will try to arrive by 3pm for the rest. Candidate confirmed the accessible room and greeter. I'll update here after first remote slot.
